name: automagik
description: Automagik: DeepSeek Harness web on 127.0.0.1:3080 with Bot, welcome and Omni channels plugins. Build with templates/automagik.build.sh PROJECT PROFILE local:BASE_FINGERPRINT (prepared amd64 Debian base; see script prerequisites). Plugins use pinned commits; npm uses the vendored lockfile. Tailscale is installed, disabled. A link to omni-api gives OMNI_API_URL.
